prompt: Tapping "like" waits 600 ms for the server before the heart fills in.
why: Fill it immediately and roll back if the request fails.
trap: Likes almost always succeed, so show success now.

prompt: New todo items appear only after a round trip, so typing several quickly feels laggy.
tells: appear only after a round trip
why: Add them to the list right away with a pending state.
trap: Debouncing would make it slower, not faster.

prompt: Moving a card on a kanban board updates instantly, and if the server rejects it, the card snaps back with a message.
trap: Offline-first queues writes; this assumes success and reverts.

prompt: Showing "Payment complete" before the bank confirms led to angry customers when cards were declined.
why: Optimistic UI is wrong for actions that often fail or matter a lot; wait for confirmation.
trap: Knowing where not to apply it is the lesson.
